PASS|XY_DEFAULT_CENTER_RECORDED|Rasterio xy center default is not implicit.
PASS|XY_CORNER_OFFSET_RECORDED|Corner offset choice is recorded for every diagnostic.
PASS|INDEX_OPERATOR_PINNED|Coordinate-to-index rounding operator is explicit.

PASS|WINDOW_STOP_CEILED|Conservative integer stops include the complete requested expanse.
PASS|HALF_OPEN_RANGE_POLICY|Integer windows use [start, stop) semantics.
PASS|WINDOW_WIDTH_HEIGHT_RECOMPUTED|Widths and heights equal stop minus start after rounding.
PASS|WINDOW_CROPPED_TO_DATASET|Read windows are clipped to raster width and height.
PASS|PRECLIP_WINDOW_RECORDED|Out-of-bounds requested window is retained for audit.
PASS|POSTCLIP_WINDOW_RECORDED|Actual dataset read window is retained.
PASS|EMPTY_INTERSECTION_FAILS|A parcel extent with no raster intersection fails closed.
PASS|WINDOW_BOUNDS_READBACK|Rounded/clipped window bounds are recomputed from the affine transform.
PASS|WINDOW_TRANSFORM_READBACK|Window-relative affine transform maps local and global indexes consistently.
PASS|ALL_PARCEL_BOUNDS_CORNERS_TRANSFORMED|All polygon-envelope corners are transformed, including rotated rasters.
PASS|RECTANGULAR_WINDOW_NOT_FINAL_MASK|Candidate window membership never substitutes for exact parcel geometry.
PASS|SAMPLE_CENTER_GEOMETRY_PREDICATE|Area-pixel sample centers use the declared exact inclusion predicate.
PASS|POINT_SUPPORT_GEOMETRY_PREDICATE|Point-pixel samples use the declared point-support predicate.
PASS|BOUNDARY_TOUCH_CLASS_SEPARATE|Boundary-only support is retained separately from accepted interior support.
PASS|ROW_COLUMN_ORDER_STABLE|Accepted and reviewed cells sort by global row then column.
PASS|NO_NUMERIC_ELEVATION_INVENTED|Numeric target elevation rows remain zero.
PASS|FINAL_READY_REMAINS_FALSE|Preparation does not satisfy runner execution or numeric target output.
PASS|WEBSITE_ROW_COUNT_EXACT|The line-by-line page renders exactly 166 rows.
